items.exampleEn: The waiter smiled pleasantly at us.
items.exampleZh: 服務生愉快地對我們微笑。

items.exampleEn: Her annoyance grew as the music got louder.
items.exampleZh: 音樂越來越大聲，她的惱怒也越來越強。

items.exampleEn: Many parents check the weather anxiously before a school trip.
items.exampleZh: 很多家長在校外教學前都會焦急地查看天氣。

items.exampleEn: The audience cheered warmly at the end of the show.
items.exampleZh: 表演結束時，觀眾熱烈地歡呼。

items.exampleEn: It was a shameful thing to do.
The teacher stopped the boys' mischief.
items.exampleZh: 老師制止了男孩們的惡作劇。

items.exampleEn: We had a relaxing weekend at home.
items.exampleZh: 我們在家度過了一個輕鬆的週末。

items.exampleEn: The old man looked lovingly at his wife.
items.exampleZh: 那位老先生深情地看著他的妻子。

items.sentenceEn: The music in this coffee shop is relaxing.
items.sentenceZh: 這家咖啡店的音樂很令人放鬆。

items.audioEn: Our new neighbors welcomed us warmly with a basket of fruit.
items.audioZh: 我們的新鄰居帶著一籃水果熱情地歡迎我們。

items.sentenceEn: The mother cat lovingly cleaned her kittens.
items.sentenceZh: 母貓慈愛地把小貓舔乾淨。

items.sentenceEn: He looked anxiously at the clock.

items.stemEn: Keep an eye on the puppy; it's always getting into ____.
items.stemZh: 盯著那隻小狗，牠老是調皮搗蛋。

items.stemEn: Lying to someone who trusts you is ____.
items.stemZh: 對信任你的人說謊是可恥的。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, we visited my grandparents in the countryside. They hugged us warmly at the door. Grandma had lovingly cooked all my favorite dishes. My little cousins were full of mischief: they hid my shoes and laughed. To my annoyance, it took me an hour to find them. In the afternoon, we sat in the gorgeous garden, which was very relaxing. Then Grandpa waited anxiously for a phone call from my aunt, who was having a baby. When the call came, everyone was pleasantly surprised: it was twins! Later, my cousin admitted that hiding my shoes was a little shameful, and he said sorry.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我們去鄉下探望爺爺奶奶。他們在門口熱情地擁抱我們。奶奶慈愛地煮了我所有最愛吃的菜。我的小表弟們非常調皮搗蛋：他們把我的鞋子藏起來，還哈哈大笑。讓我惱怒的是，我花了一個小時才找到鞋子。下午，我們坐在美極了的花園裡，非常令人放鬆。接著，爺爺焦急地等著阿姨打來的電話，因為她快生寶寶了。電話打來時，大家都又驚又喜：是雙胞胎！後來，我表弟承認藏我的鞋子有點丟臉，還向我道了歉。

questions.questionZh: 小表弟們做了什麼惡作劇？
options: 在奶奶做的菜裡加了很多鹽
郵差送來的一個大包裹

items.promptZh: 他熱情地謝謝我們的幫忙。
referenceEn: He warmly thanked us for our help.

rubricZh: warmly 表示「熱情地」，例如 thank someone warmly 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.promptZh: 泡個熱水澡很令人放鬆。
referenceEn: Taking a hot bath is very relaxing.
A hot bath is really relaxing.
rubricZh: 用 relaxing 表示「令人放鬆的」（寫 relaxed 時主詞要是人）
